title: Himalaya Nutravedics India IPO Details
intro:
Himalaya Nutravedics IPO is a book build issue of ₹26.50 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 25.00 lakh shares of ₹26.50 crore.

Himalaya Nutravedics IPO opens for subscription on Sep 22, 2026 and closes on Sep 24, 2026. The allotment for the Himalaya Nutravedics IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 25, 2026. Himalaya Nutravedics IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 29, 2026.

Himalaya Nutravedics IPO is set issue price band at ₹100 to ₹106 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,54,400 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,81,600.

Nirbhay Capital Services Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Allwin Securities Ltd.

Refer to Himalaya Nutravedics IPO RHP for detailed Information.

The Company manufactures a diversified portfolio comprising classical (Shastric) Ayurvedic formulations, proprietary Ayurvedic formulations and nutraceutical supplements. Its products are available in multiple dosage forms, including soft gelatin capsules, hard gelatin capsules, tablets, liquid orals and medicated oils. The products cater to therapeutic and wellness areas such as gut health, cardiac and metabolic wellness, diabetes management, pain management, immunity, women’s wellness and general wellness.

Himalaya Nutravedics operates through a hybrid business model comprising its own branded products and third-party contract manufacturing. Under its own-brand business, the Company develops, manufactures and markets Ayurvedic and nutraceutical products, while its third-party manufacturing business provides formulation, manufacturing, packaging and dispatch services based on client specifications. As of March 31, 2026, its own-brand business contributed approximately ₹2,202.54 lakh, representing about 51.14% of total revenue.

The Company operates an integrated manufacturing facility in Hyderabad, Telangana, where formulation, production, quality control, packaging and finished-goods release are carried out internally. The facility is compliant with WHO-GMP standards and holds registrations and licences from AYUSH and FSSAI, along with certifications including ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22000:2018, HACCP, HALAL and KOSHER.
As of July 31, 2026, the Company had 86 full-time employees across marketing, factory, finance, quality, compliance and administration functions.

faqs.question: How to apply in Himalaya Nutravedics IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Himalaya Nutravedics IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Himalaya Nutravedics IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Himalaya Nutravedics IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Himalaya Nutravedics IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in Himalaya Nutravedics IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
